result.summary: The page renders correctly overall, but the promotional banner has a serious contrast problem: white text ('3 free deliveries for you', the promo code line, and even the 'Order now' label) sits on a very light mint-green background, making it barely readable.

issues.description: Promotional banner text is white on a very pale mint-green background. The heading '3 free deliveries for you', the subtitle 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10', and even the 'Order now' button label all have extremely low contrast against the light background, making them difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color (e.g., dark green or near-black) for the heading and description on the light banner, or darken the banner background so white text passes WCAG contrast requirements.
